defs.def: an official document that may be used to prove that the facts it states are true 证明；证明书

ex.s: Health Certificate and Social Security card.
Medical certificate：You must provide a medical certificate indicating you are fit to work．
ex.t: 体检证明：你必须提供一份表明你身体状况适合工作的体检证明。
一份用于工作的体检证明。

defs.def: an official document proving that you have completed a course of study or passed an exam; a qualification obtained after a course of study or an exam 文凭；结业证书；合格证书

ex.s: Zhang Tian graduated from university and 10 got a teacher's certificate last year.
ex.t: 张天大学毕业，去年取得了教师证书。

ex.s: My university life I had been waiting with my fellow graduating students for the moment when I would walk out onto the stage to receive my degree certificate.
ex.t: 在我的大学生活中，我一直在与即将毕业的同学们一起等待着我走上舞台获得学位证书的那一刻。

ex.s: I held my certificate against my breast and smiled at the camera.
ex.t: 我把证书贴在胸前，对着相机微笑。

ex.s: I stood with my certificate in hand and reflected on those four years.
ex.t: 我手里拿着证书站着，反思那四年。
